component.name: GPGMan
component.summary: OpenPGP and GnuPG key manager with a GUI and CLI

description.p: GPGMan manages GPG keys and performs OpenPGP operations from a modern GTK4 desktop interface or an equivalent terminal CLI.

ul.li: Create, import, export and delete keys, including drag-and-drop key import
Encrypt and decrypt messages and files
Sign and verify text and files
Import keys by dragging and dropping key files onto the Keys view
Open .asc files from your file manager to import keys, decrypt messages or verify signatures
Secret key export now prompts for the passphrase on any desktop environment
Fixed the application icon and name in the dock
